title: Best Robotic Arm (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were based on products explicitly mentioned in sources [1], [2] and [3]. The product with the most source coverage was chosen as the top pick.

verdict.pick: Roborock Saros Z70 Robot Vacuum and Mop with OmniGrip Mechanical Arm
verdict.line: Buy it if you want a home robot that vacuums, mops and can pick up items, as noted by CNET and Consumer Reports. The main catch is its occasional arm‑gripping and software issues.
